notes: Next.js/Tailwind storefront (looks like a SumUp/Storefront platform - images served from images.sumup.com). Styling classes are utility (Tailwind) and could change on redeploy, but stable 'data-selector' attributes exist and are used instead - preferred over the Tailwind classes for durability. The product_container link itself carries the price/name/stock as descendants (it wraps the whole card, no separate outer wrapper element). Only 16 products found on this page with no pagination controls, load-more button, or next link detected, so treated as single-page; note category may use client-side filtering/infinite scroll not visible without further interaction, so max_pages could need revisiting. Out-of-stock items show Loppuunmyyty inside .list-product-price-wrapper; in_stock left null since the reliable signal is ABSENCE of that '.product-sold-out-label' element within the container, not a positive marker.
